text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Eksais (Pangkor) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2025.

Duti eksais

2. Duti eksais hendaklah dilevi atas dan dibayar oleh pengimport berkenaan dengan

barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang diimport masuk ke dalam Pangkor

atau diangkut dari kawasan utama kastam ke Pangkor pada kadar duti yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (5) Jadual kepada Perintah Duti Eksais 2025 [P.U. (A) 389/2025].

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Duti Eksais (Pangkor) 2022 [P.U. (A) 174/2022] dibatalkan.

Bil.

(2)

2. Rokok

(1)

6. Sediaan yang digunakan untuk merokok melalui rokok elektronik dan

tidak mengandungi nikotin

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

[Akan dibentangkan di hadapan Dewan Rakyat menurut subseksyen 91U(2) Akta Eksais 1976]

EXCISE ACT 1976

EXCISE DUTIES (PANGKOR) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 91U(1)(a) of the Excise Act 1976

[Act 176] read together with paragraph 91V(b) of the Act, the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Excise Duties (Pangkor) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2025.

Excise duties

2. Excise duties shall be levied on and paid by the importer in respect of

the goods specified in the Schedule which are imported into Pangkor or transported from

the principal customs area to Pangkor at the rates of duties specified in column (5)

of the Schedule to the Excise Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 389/2025].

Revocation

3. The Excise Duties (Pangkor) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 174/2022] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

(1)

No.

(2)

Goods

1. Motor vehicles

2. Cigarettes

3. Tobacco products

4. Electronic cigarettes and similar personal electric vaporizing devices

(1)

No.

(2)

Goods

5. Smoking pipes (including pipe bowls)

6. Preparation used for smoking through electronic cigarettes and

electric vaporizing device, in form of liquid or gel, whether or

not containing nicotine

Made 31 October 2025

[S.KE.HT(96)669/12-128-1; MOF.TAX(R)700-2/2/30 JLD.3; PN(PU2)337/JLD.29]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Minister of Finance II
